about: The account_type claim, the same on both deployments. Supabase: the access token hook public.api_access_token_hook (db/supabase/0002_account_claim.sql). AWS: Cognito groups with these names (session F). Both read session B's api_accounts. Tests check this file against api/openapi.yaml and core/src/platform/types.ts.
source: api_accounts: one row per account. The claim is the row's account_type.
readWhen: When the token is issued. A role change shows after the token refreshes.
precedenceUse: Only if an account somehow holds two roles: take the first in this list. The artist endpoints then refuse the account, because its claim is not artist.
cognitoRule: Each user is in exactly one group: the one named by their api_accounts.account_type. No row, or a suspended row, means no group, and no group means end_user. There is no end_user group. If a user is ever in more than one group, the claim is the group with the lowest precedence number (Cognito's own group precedence is set to the same numbers).
